newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Odds of 14-1 versus 10 mln punt lotto jackpot.
newsitem.headline: Odds of 14-1 versus 10 mln punt lotto jackpot.

text.p: As national lottery fever gripped Ireland, Dublin bookmakers on Thursday offered odds of 14-1 against the jackpot reaching 10 million punts in 1996.
They offered odds of 40-1 against a single winner of a 10 million punts Irish Lotto jackpot in 1996.
For next Saturday's draw, bookmakers offered 2-1 against no winning jackpot ticket and the same odds against exactly one winning ticket.
There was no winner of Wednesday night's Irish lottery jackpot of a record 6.05 million punts, and next Saturday's jackpot is expected to be over seven million punts.
